title_as_printed: Experimentally determined densities (rho) of pure CO2 at 400C. The numbers in column 3 are differences between densities obtained in this study and those previously determined by Seitz and Blencoe (1996) at the same P-T conditions
pressure_note: Pressure P (MPa) given in the tables, isobaric-isothermal conditions; paper states accuracy +-0.02 MPa; not otherwise defined (flow-through cell, no vapour phase; total pressure presumed but not stated)

value2.what: this study minus Seitz and Blencoe (1996) density at same P,T; comparison with the authors' earlier measurement, not a density

composition.other_species: pure CO2 fluid at 400 C; contains no water and no salt (not an aqueous system)

extra_unmapped: delta rho_exp (blank cells where no earlier measurement at that P)
notes: Pure CO2 density at 400 C. Blank cells in delta rho_exp are printed blanks. Standard conditions not applicable (density).
hold_table: pure CO2 density at 400 C, no water component: not a brine/water density; the rho converter would store it as pure water (audit 2026-10-02; title 'densities (rho) of pure CO2 at 400C')
